en_title: The Binding of Isaac Dev Removes Undisclosed AI-Generated Music From Repentance+ Following Creator Response, Review-Bombing
cn_title: 《以撒的结合》开发商在创作者回应及玩家集中刷差评后移除了未披露的AI生成音乐
opus_summary: 《The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+》更新因包含未披露的AI生成音乐遭到Steam玩家差评轰炸。创作者Edmund McMillen表示对此毫不知情，并着手调查和移除音乐。开发商Nicalis随后发布PC补丁移除相关文件，其他平台的补丁已提交，但上线时间未定。

paragraphs.en: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis has removed undisclosed AI-generated music included in Repentance+ after backlash led to a review-bombing campaign on Steam and a response from the game's creator, Edmund McMillen.
paragraphs.cn: 在玩家的强烈反对引发Steam集中刷差评，并促使游戏创作者Edmund McMillen作出回应后，《以撒的结合》开发商Nicalis移除了《Repentance+》中未披露的AI生成音乐。

paragraphs.en: McMillen and Nicalis spent months building up to the November 19, 2026, release date for the latest update in their classic action roguelike game, but that launch was quickly soured. Just 8% of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'s recent Steam reviews are positive, with a good chunk of comments left by players referencing AI-generated material that was not previously mentioned in any official capacity.
paragraphs.cn: McMillen和Nicalis花了数月时间为他们这款经典动作肉鸽游戏的最新更新造势，准备于2026年11月19日推出，但这次发布很快就蒙上了阴影。《以撒的结合：忏悔+》近期在Steam上的评价中只有8%为好评，相当一部分玩家评论提到了此前从未通过任何官方渠道提及的AI生成内容。

paragraphs.en: "Thanks, Nicalis, for breaking everything and adding AI slop to an already-existing game!" one popular review said .
paragraphs.cn: 一条热门评论写道：「谢谢你，Nicalis，把一切都搞坏了，还往一款已有的游戏里添加AI垃圾！」

paragraphs.en: "I'm starting to think that adding AI to a game should be valid grounds to refunds to people who have already paid for and played a game," another said . "Shameful they would do this to an Indie gem. Shameful."
paragraphs.cn: 另一条评论写道：「我开始觉得，往游戏里加入AI应该成为已付费并玩过游戏的玩家要求退款的正当理由。他们竟然对一款独立游戏佳作做出这种事，真可耻。可耻。」

paragraphs.en: The allegedly AI-generated content in question seems to be music exclusively tied to a specific, Grand Theft Auto-themed run meant to coincide with the recent release of GTA 6 . What could have been a cute jab at another gaming titan boiled into a full-blown controversy for Nicalis when Reddit user ShweetsStuff reported the questionable tunes just one day after launch.
paragraphs.cn: 引发争议的据称由AI生成的内容，似乎是专门用于某个以《侠盗猎车手》为主题的特定游戏流程的音乐，该流程旨在配合《GTA 6》近期发售。这本可能是对另一款游戏巨作的一次俏皮调侃，但在Reddit用户ShweetsStuff于发布仅一天后指出这些可疑曲目时，此事演变成了Nicalis面临的一场全面争议。

paragraphs.en: As artificial intelligence advances, it's become increasingly difficult to discern human-made art from content pushed out by machines, but ShweetsStuff was able to provide evidence backing their claims. Specifically, they pointed to a handful of tracks that mention AI music software Suno in their metadata, which also included links to their Suno pages.
paragraphs.cn: 随着人工智能的发展，区分人类创作的艺术作品与机器生成的内容变得越来越困难，但ShweetsStuff提供了证据来支持其说法。具体而言，他们指出几首曲目的元数据中提到了AI音乐软件Suno，其中还包含指向这些曲目Suno页面的链接。

paragraphs.en: AI-generated content passed off as art has already become controversial on its own in recent years. Adding to the fire for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ was the fact that the music was featured in the new update without any sort of update to its Steam description. Valve requires developers to disclose how they may have used AI during game development, making the music's inclusion as puzzling as it is concerning for those who felt Nicalis had pulled the wool over their eyes.
paragraphs.cn: 近年来，将AI生成内容冒充艺术作品本身就已引发争议。而对《以撒的结合：忏悔+》而言，火上浇油的是，这些音乐出现在新更新中，但其Steam描述却没有作出任何更新。Valve要求开发者披露他们在游戏开发过程中可能使用AI的方式，因此，对于那些觉得Nicalis蒙骗了自己的人来说，这些音乐被加入游戏既令人费解，也令人担忧。

paragraphs.en: Negative reviews poured in following ShweetsStuff's discovery, leading McMillen to issue a statement today. He said he “had no idea" how AI-generated music found its way into the launch build of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'s new update.
paragraphs.cn: 在ShweetsStuff发现此事后，差评如潮水般涌来，促使McMillen于今天发表声明。他表示，自己「完全不知道」AI生成音乐是如何进入《以撒的结合：忏悔+》新更新的首发版本的。

paragraphs.en: "Woke up to a s**t show," he said , "obviously I had no idea it featured generated music in the daily run, looking into how that happened and getting it removed, stay tuned."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「一觉醒来就看到一团糟。显然，我完全不知道每日挑战中有生成音乐，正在调查这是怎么发生的，并将其移除，请继续关注。」

paragraphs.en: Please report issues and bugs to the email attached.
paragraphs.cn: 请通过附上的电子邮箱报告问题和漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Just hours later, Nicalis launched a new patch, confirming the "removal of generated music files." The update is currently live for PC, with the studio adding that it has already been submitted to Microsoft, Nintendo, and Sony. When exactly it will go live for those platforms remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 仅仅数小时后，Nicalis推出了一个新补丁，确认「移除了生成的音乐文件」。该更新目前已在PC端上线，工作室补充称，更新已提交给微软、任天堂和索尼。它究竟何时会在这些平台上线，还有待观察。

paragraphs.en: No explanation for how or why the AI-generated music was included was provided. Instead, the team simply said it was "working on the game and will continue to address new and old bugs." McMillen also encouraged fans to report issues and bugs to the developers.
paragraphs.cn: 团队没有解释AI生成音乐是如何或为何被加入的，只是表示正在「继续开发游戏，并将持续处理新旧漏洞」。McMillen也鼓励粉丝向开发者报告问题和漏洞。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'s recent reviews on Steam remain firmly in the "Overwhelmingly Negative" category. The major update also coincided with the launch of Repentance+ on new platforms, including Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. For more, you can read IGN's 9/10 review for The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and our 9/10 review for Afterbirth+ .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《以撒的结合：忏悔+》近期在Steam上的评价仍稳居「差评如潮」类别。这次重大更新也恰逢《Repentance+》登陆新平台，包括Switch 2、PS5和XBOX Series。想了解更多，可以阅读IGN为《以撒的结合：重生》给出9/10分的评测，以及我们为《Afterbirth+》给出9/10分的评测。
